title: Selective Demonstration Retrieval for Improved Implicit Hate Speech Detection
reasoning: The paper focuses on a technical framework (ARIIHA) for improving implicit hate speech detection through adaptive retrieval in Large Language Models. While it uses examples involving religious identities (e.g., 'white Jews' or 'Hindus') to test for over-sensitivity and classification accuracy, it does not benchmark or evaluate religion, faith, spiritual traditions, or ethical systems themselves.
